title: Teen Bead Builder
shareTitle: Teen Bead Builder — Build Teen Numbers
description: Bundle ten loose clay beads into one ten, count on with extra ones, and match base-ten bead models to every teen numeral from 11 to 19.
learningGoals: See ten loose ones regroup into one bundled ten
Compose every teen number as one ten plus additional ones
Count on from ten instead of recounting the whole quantity
Connect base-ten bead models with written teen numerals
interactionModel: tap-or-drag an infinite clay bead into forgiving ten and ones frames; remove placed beads before completion; tap large nearby numeral cards to match a bead model
feedbackModel: beads pop into visible grid positions, the tenth bead bundles into a tied ten bar, off-tray drags return gently, wrong numeral cards wiggle, and every success speaks and shows the complete ten-plus-ones equation

modes.title: Bundle & Build
modes.skill: compose teen numbers as one ten and some ones

modes.title: Bead Detective
modes.skill: match a base-ten bead model to its teen numeral
